description.p: A Bomberman-like arcade game written in Python with Pygame. Throw bombs, destroy bricks, collect power-ups, and survive enemy waves and snipers.
High scores are persistently saved again and portable: the signing key no longer depends on the process ID, only on the local .bombkey salt, so the board survives restarts and folder moves
Sniper cooldown 30s, bomb score display at damage location, Linux Flatpak support
